questions.question: An employee who lives abroad now and moves into Switzerland has no previous canton. Should we ask for the new canton in that case, and does it count as a change of canton for the tax office? The decision table (rows 1–3) and AC-04.3.1 assume a previous canton always exists for Swiss moves. OQ-04 covers the payroll side of this, not the canton side.

If the previous canton comes from HR's records, what happens when it is missing or out of date for an employee (for example, an earlier move was never reported)? Should the employee be asked, should the canton always be asked, or should HR be flagged to check?

AC-04.1.2 says HR 'receives the new canton … so it can pass the change of canton to the tax office.' What exactly does HR receive? Is the report clearly marked as a change of canton, or does it just include the canton value? Is passing it to the tax office a manual HR step and out of scope, or should the product notify the tax office?

AC-04.1.3 says the employee 'names a Swiss canton' but no list or wording is defined. Should the choice be limited to the 26 cantons? Which names count (English, German, French or Italian names, or official abbreviations like ZH or BE)? G-02 only sets the wording for countries. Without this, the criterion cannot be tested.

The tax office handles source tax by canton, so a canton change can matter to payroll too. Is 'No other stakeholder receives the new canton' (AC-04.1.2) confirmed with HR or payroll? Also, does the tax office need the previous canton? AC-04.3.3 says the previous canton is not passed on, and its own trace check says no source supports that.
If the employee is asked for the new canton and gives one, must it match the canton of the new postcode or town? What should happen if it does not match?

The trace check says P1 is 'not backed by the facts'. Can product confirm the priority of US-04.1 and US-04.3? Also, until OQ-01 is decided, should FEAT-01 to FEAT-03 ship without any canton handling, and should HR handle canton changes manually in the meantime?

already_flagged: OQ-01: How a change of canton is detected for Swiss moves (ask the employee, use HR's records, or always ask for the new canton). This blocks AC-04.1.1, AC-04.2.1 and AC-04.3.1, which assume the new canton is compared before it is known.

tech_leaks.quote: The internal condition can only check this once both cantons are known.
tech_leaks.why: Describes how the system evaluates the rule internally instead of what the business needs. How and when the comparison runs should be left to engineering.
